videos.title: The End of the Static Screen: Architecting Intent-Driven UX — Gus Iwanaga, commercetools
videos.summary: Building user interfaces around dynamic LLM outputs often breaks standard frontend patterns. This talk explores how to architect intent-driven UX that handles model variance and prevents production UI failures.

videos.title: Will there be less SWEs in 10 years?
videos.summary: Junior engineers constantly hear alarming predictions about AI replacing developers. Hear directly from the creator of Scala on how the engineering job market will realistically evolve over the next decade.

videos.title: Agentic video understanding in Gemini
videos.summary: Processing large multimodal files like long videos can drain your API budget rapidly. This tutorial breaks down how to use agentic workflows to slash token overhead while boosting retrieval accuracy.

videos.title: [S03:E74] TAK MAMPU ambil takaful, isu DUIT atau PRIORITI? - Azam Yusof & Mohamad Saifudin
videos.summary: Understanding the difference between conventional insurance and Shariah-compliant takaful is crucial for your long-term wealth planning. This episode breaks down how hibah and takaful protect young families without compromising Islamic principles.

videos.title: Apa fungsi credit score?
videos.summary: As an early-career engineer in Malaysia, understanding CCRIS and credit scores is vital before applying for major facilities like home financing. This quick guide clarifies how banks evaluate your risk profile.

videos.title: Jangan pinjamkan nama untuk joint loan?
videos.summary: Lending your name for a joint loan can jeopardize your financial future and debt-service ratios. Learn why this common Malaysian dilemma carries severe long-term liabilities.

videos.title: [S01:E22]  Credit Card vs BNPL:  Mana sebenarnya lebih bahaya? - Norliza Rahmat & Fairuz Izwan
videos.summary: Balancing entry-level engineering salaries with modern credit tools like BNPL and credit cards requires tight discipline. This in-depth discussion reveals how hidden commitments compound and how to manage debt responsibly.

videos.title: #113 | Never Quit On Your Goals (Leon Jala)
videos.summary: Sustaining momentum early in your career requires more than raw enthusiasm. Leon Jala shares the DMS framework (Do, Monitor, Solve) alongside lessons learned from navigating tough career performance reviews.

videos.title: Most Replayed: They Ignored Upin & Ipin | Founder & Managing Director of Les’ Copaque Production
videos.summary: Discover how Les' Copaque built the multi-million dollar Upin & Ipin brand from Malaysia against conventional odds. A great look at local entrepreneurship, IP monetization, and business resilience.

videos.title: Why You Can't Afford a Normal Life Anymore | Imam Tom Facchine
videos.summary: Modern economic systems often leave young professionals feeling overworked yet financially stagnant. Imam Tom Facchine breaks down why this occurs and offers an Islamic perspective on navigating contemporary financial pressures.

videos.title: Is Any Income Actually Halal Anymore? | Signs of the Hour Ep. 15 | Dr. Omar Suleiman
videos.summary: Earning a truly pure income in a globalized economy fraught with doubtful financial structures is a primary concern for Muslim professionals. Dr. Omar Suleiman explains the prophetic warnings on wealth and how to safeguard barakah in your earnings.

videos.title: Everyone Around You Is On A Clock Too | Dr. Omar Suleiman
videos.summary: Early-career ambitions often tempt us to postpone being present for parents and family until we reach certain milestones. This reminder reframes time and urgency around life's most essential responsibilities.

videos.title: How The Best Engineers Solve Problems Most Give Up On (Niantic Spatial CTO)
videos.summary: Leveling up from junior to senior requires mastering problem-solving when documentation and answers run out. Niantic Spatial's CTO shares how top engineers tackle intractable technical roadblocks and ship complex software.

videos.title: If you've been at the same company 3+ years, you're already in a box
videos.summary: Staying in your technical comfort zone can stunt your career trajectory as a developer. This breakdown explains why understanding broader business architecture is the key to stepping beyond junior limitations.

videos.title: How new staff engineers build judgment without years of experience
videos.summary: Now that AI models can generate boilerplate code instantly, an engineer's value lies in architectural judgment. Learn how rising developers can cultivate strategic decision-making skills early in their careers.
